items.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: You know I’ve had a lot of people call me that I couldn’t go work with. Horace Silver, Art Farmer, just hear their voices on the phone.

ctx.x: Well I’m glad the music won out personally.

Well I look at it as I was destined to. I don’t understand it. For me, like I say, I wasn’t bragging when I said that I never had a real day gig or like that. I’m overwhelmingly humbled by, hey, I got to do what I want to do, man. You know. Look, I can’t think of anything greater. I mean it hasn’t been easy. There was times when I was saying, “Which bank am I going to rob.” No I’m dramatizing, but I’m saying there were times when I lived in a room a fourth the size of this room we’re in now. I had to walk up four…
